newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Yahoo! cut to market perform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Yahoo! cut to market perform.

text.p: EVEREN Securities Inc said Thursday it cut its intermediate-term rating on Internet search tool company Yahoo! Inc to market performer from outperform, because the stock surpassed EVEREN's intermediate-term price target of $35.
--- But EVEREN also raised its 1997 earnings estimate to $0.09 a share for the company from its previous view of $0.05. The company reported a loss of $0.09 a share for 1996.
-- Long-term rating remains outperform, EVEREN said.
-- Yahoo! shares were down one at 43 Thursday.
